entries.english: Accept payments and grow your business. Stripe's official MCP server enables AI agents to manage customers, products, prices, payment links, invoices, subscriptions, and refunds, as well as search Stripe documentation.
entries.chinese: 接收付款并拓展业务。Stripe 官方 MCP 服务器让智能体管理客户、产品、价格、付款链接、发票、订阅和退款，并搜索 Stripe 文档。

entries.english: Databricks skills for the CLI, Apps, Lakebase, Model Serving, Lakeflow Jobs, Spark Declarative Pipelines, Declarative Automation Bundles (DABs), and classic-to-serverless migration.
entries.chinese: 适用于 Databricks CLI、Apps、Lakebase、模型服务、Lakeflow Jobs、Spark 声明式流水线、声明式自动化包（DABs）及传统架构向无服务器架构迁移的技能。

entries.english: Search Intercom conversations, contacts, and companies, spot support trends, and install the Intercom Messenger with secure identity verification.
entries.chinese: 搜索 Intercom 对话、联系人和公司，发现客户支持趋势，并安装带有安全身份验证的 Intercom Messenger。

entries.english: SEO workflows on live Semrush data: keyword research, site audits, backlinks, competitor, traffic and market analytics, PPC, and AI brand visibility.
entries.chinese: 基于 Semrush 实时数据开展 SEO 工作：关键词研究、网站审计、反向链接、竞争对手、流量与市场分析、点击付费广告及 AI 品牌可见度分析。

entries.english: Search and read your Wispr Flow meeting notes, transcripts, scratchpad notes, and calendar events. Read-only access to your own account.

entries.chinese: 在 Antigravity 中管理 Bigin CRM：查看销售流程、查找联系人和商机、记录通话、安排跟进并向客户发送邮件。

entries.chinese: 连接你管理的 Looker MCP 服务器，探索数据、运行已保存的 Look、构建仪表板并验证 LookML。
